statement: Whenever valid_path n edges source destination returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exist an integer m >= 0 and vertices v_0, ..., v_m such that (1) 0 <= v_j < n for every j with 0 <= j <= m, (2) v_0 = source, (3) v_m = destination, and (4) for every j with 0 <= j < m, the unordered pair {v_j, v_{j+1}} equals the unordered pair {edges[i][0], edges[i][1]} for some i with 0 <= i < len(edges). Equivalently, r = false exactly when no such sequence exists.
preconditions: 1 <= n <= 200000; 0 <= len(edges) <= 200000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(edges), len(edges[i]) = 2, 0 <= edges[i][0] < n, 0 <= edges[i][1] < n, and edges[i][0] != edges[i][1]; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(edges), the unordered pair {edges[i][0], edges[i][1]} is not equal to the unordered pair {edges[j][0], edges[j][1]}; and 0 <= source < n and 0 <= destination < n.
